objective: Postcheck fisico independiente posterior al workflow R5 fallido 34795505979. Confirmar identidad SQL, conteo y nombres exactos de las cuatro vistas Customer360. Solo SELECT; sin DDL ni DML.

queries.name: r5_postcheck_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: r5_postcheck_present_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS present_count FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND v.name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360')

queries.name: r5_postcheck_present_names
queries.sql: SELECT v.name AS view_name FROM sys.views v JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=v.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND v.name IN ('vw_RRR_ClienteActividadComercial','vw_RRR_ClienteScoreActual','vw_RRR_ClienteRankingActual','vw_RRR_Customer360') ORDER BY v.name
